title.zh: 專注產業｜半導體、科技製造、IT 與金融｜HiReKing
title.en: Industries | Semiconductor, Manufacturing, Technology & Finance | HiReKing

desc.zh: HiReKing 專注半導體、科技製造與電子零組件、科技／IT 軟體與金融專業服務四個產業，顧問各自負責熟悉的領域。
desc.en: HiReKing focuses on four markets — semiconductor, advanced manufacturing and electronics, technology and IT, and financial and professional services — with consultants dedicated to each.

title.zh: 四個市場，各有專責顧問
title.en: Four markets, each with its own consultants

sub.zh: 我們不做全產業通吃。顧問只負責自己熟悉的領域——因為職缺描述的精準度與人選判斷的準確度，都建立在對產業的理解上。
sub.en: We do not cover everything. Each consultant works only in the market they know, because the accuracy of a job brief and the judgement of a candidate both rest on understanding that industry.

body.zh: 晶圓製造、封裝測試、IC 設計與設備材料。製程、設備、整合、良率、封裝、驗證與廠級主管職。這是 HiReKing 來台灣的主要原因。
body.en: Wafer fabrication, OSAT, IC design, equipment and materials — process, equipment, integration, yield, packaging, verification and plant leadership. This is why HiReKing came to Taiwan.

body.zh: 面板、被動元件、PCB、光電、精密機械與系統組裝。製程、設備、品保、自動化與廠務幹部，含海外廠派駐與當地招募。
body.en: Display, passive components, PCB, optoelectronics, precision machinery and system assembly — process, equipment, QA, automation and plant leadership, including overseas assignments.

body.zh: 韌體、嵌入式、後端、前端、資料與資安工程師，以及產品經理、技術主管與 CTO 級人選。與半導體業的軟韌體需求高度重疊。
body.en: Firmware, embedded, backend, frontend, data and security engineers, plus product managers, engineering leads and CTO-level hires — overlapping heavily with semiconductor software demand.

body.zh: 會計、財務、法遵、風控、法務與顧問職。重視證照條件與背景查核，也支援科技與製造業內部的財會與法務團隊擴編。
body.en: Accounting, finance, compliance, risk, legal and advisory roles where credentials and background checks matter — including finance and legal build-outs inside technology and manufacturing firms.

title.zh: 這四塊的人才是流動的

body.zh:
半導體廠的自動化工程師會流到系統廠；IC 設計的韌體工程師與科技業的嵌入式人才在同一個池子裡；擴編中的科技公司需要的財務與法遵人才，來自金融與四大會計師事務所。

把這四塊一起看，我們才判斷得出一個人選真正的市場價值，以及你的職缺實際上在跟誰競爭。

其他產業的委任案，若不在我們的能力範圍內，我們會直接告訴你，並在可能的情況下轉介給合適的同業。
body.en:
An automation engineer in a fab moves to a systems maker. Firmware engineers in IC design sit in the same pool as embedded talent in technology. And the finance and compliance people a scaling technology company needs come from banking and the Big Four.

Covering all four is what lets us judge a candidate's real market value — and tell you who your vacancy is actually competing against.

If an assignment falls outside what we can genuinely do, we will say so, and refer you to a firm that can where we are able.

title.en: Which market is your role in?

body.zh: 不確定也沒關係，講給我們聽，我們會告訴你這個缺實際上在跟哪些公司搶人。
body.en: Not sure? Describe it and we will tell you which companies you are actually competing with for that person.
